description: submission.rs line 615 emits format!("#{call_id}") as the call-id for the implicit Email/set invocation. RFC 8621 §7.5 is explicit: 'both have the same method call id as they are due to the same call in the request'. The implicit Email/set MUST use the parent call-id verbatim (same as EmailSubmission/set's call-id), not a hash-prefixed variant. Clients correlating method responses by call-id will fail.
title: EmailSubmission/set implicit Email/set uses wrong call-id
